outcome: Diaphragm muscle fibre oxidative capacity (Type I and IIb)
Diaphragm muscle fibre cross-sectional area (Type I, IIa, IIb/d)
cohort: Pregnant spiny mice fed control or creatine-supplemented diets, and their pups subjected to in-utero asphyxia or control conditions.
finding: Maternal creatine supplementation during pregnancy prevents long-term diaphragm muscle fatigue and structural changes induced by birth asphyxia in spiny mouse offspring.
